after previously writing a good review of the surgery and of Doctor Tang i feel i need to make corrections.
After suffering an incident in july 23 ive been left unable to work, sit, stand or walk. Ive had mri’s and xrays showing both l5/s1 disc bulge and osteoarthritis of the hips, oh then a month later apparently im clear of the latter. Ive begged for help to get me back contributing in society but to no avail. They offer me drugs i cant take, ive begged for injections in si joint but refuse and at best have been offered physio at the surgery, ive done physio the whole time. They have not offered me MSK physio, they haven’t even tried to get to the bottom of the source of my pain so that i can at least help myself to the correct exercises.
The most alarming thing and was not going to go public with this but after a lot of reflection have decided to pursue through nhs complaints was, in february, dr harding thought he was doing the right thing taking me off a drug (gabapentin) which i had been on for 12 years and took me off it in 1 week!!! Causing me a whole load of mental trauma, night sweats, suicidal tendencies and probably a lot more pain from the mental anguish!! At best this was reckless behaviour by a dr!
Im left with no faith in the surgery and after being compared to a knackered car that you wouldn’t chuck parts at by dr oxley this morning, my fairh in the nhs as a whole is a shambles!!!",null,[0,192]]]],[],[null,null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/reviews/data=!4m8!14m7!1m6!2m5!1sChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURQak5pRlJREAE!2m1!1s0x0:0xc741399a0ab3262e!3m1!1s2@1:CIHM0ogKEICAgIDPjNiFRQ%7C%7C?hl=en"],["https://www.google.com/local/content/rap/report?postId=ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURQak5pRlJREAE&t=1&entityid=ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURQak5pRlJREi0KFkNJSE0wb2dLRUlDQWdJRFBqTmlGSlESE0Nnd0lfT1NudWdZUWdQakFoQUUaLgoXQ0lITTBvZ0tFSUNBZ0lEUGpOaUZwUUUSE0Nnd0lfT1NudWdZUWdQakFoQUUiEgkAAAAAAAAAABEuJrMKmjlBxyoTQ2d3SV9PU251Z1lRZ1BqQWhBRQ&wv=1&d=286732320",null,null,"0ahUKEwix_vjN-66TAxUdIWMBHUkSK10QoykIFigB"],null,[null,[[1,1]]]],"0ahUKEwix_vjN-66TAxUdIWMBHUkSK10Q0pMFCBQoBg"],null,"CAESY0NBRVFCeHBFUTJwRlNVRlNTWEJEWjI5QlVEY3lSM2xJU2sxeFMxOWZSV2hFVlhrM2NrazBkR3Q2VEZoMFJGOVJNRUZCUVVGQlIyZHVPVEkyUlVOaVNXTnJlVzl2V1VGRFNVRQ=="],[["ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURYa2U2Y0xREAE",["0x0:0xc741399a0ab3262e",null,1730104472130177,1730105158154993,[null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/110142924550672492317/reviews?hl=en"],null,null,["Anna G","https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocLNDiXk3_WqWqv2hSG2svFRc3EsaQVn0D7qyhnFkr3vTylXaBUL=s120-c-rp-mo-br100",["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/110142924550672492317?hl=en"],"110142924550672492317",null,5,0,null,[0,3,1],0,["5 reviews",null,null,null,null,[null,"0ahUKEwix_vjN-66TAxUdIWMBHUkSK10Q7LoGCBgoAA"]]]],null,"a year ago",null,null,null,null,null,null,["Google","https://www.gstatic.com/images/branding/product/1x/googleg_48dp.png",null,null,5],null,1],[[1],null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,["en"],[["Isn't it awful that, before I even phone at 7:59 am, I know I'm going to be asked if I can travel somewhere else?
